primaryMetricFormula: dvsSuccessesAmongValidRuns / validRuns, computed separately per arm

pairedTaskEligibility.includeIff: both Native and MAF task-arm cells are DETERMINATE

mcnemar.variant: two-sided exact McNemar / two-sided exact binomial on discordant pairs under p=0.5
mcnemar.zeroDiscordancePolicy: pValue=1 by construction; not evidence of equivalence

pairedDifferenceCi.citation: Newcombe RG (1998). Improved confidence intervals for the difference between binomial proportions based on paired data. Statistics in Medicine 17:2635-2650. Method 10.
pairedDifferenceCi.inputs: n11, n10, n01, n00 on the eligible paired-task set
pairedDifferenceCi.innerIntervals: Wilson 1927 score interval on each paired marginal
pairedDifferenceCi.phi: continuity-corrected phi: if A=0 then 0; else if eh-fg>0 then max(eh-fg-n/2,0)/sqrt(A); else (eh-fg)/sqrt(A)
pairedDifferenceCi.boundaryPolicy: clamp radicands at 0; clamp interval to [-1,1]; n=0 => INAPPLICABLE
pairedDifferenceCi.zeroDiscordancePolicy: non-degenerate Method 10 interval around 0; not a proof of equivalence
pairedDifferenceCi.roundingPolicy: persist IEEE-754 binary64; print 6 decimal places

unequalDenominatorPolicy: leave run-level and descriptive task-level denominators unequal when invalidation is asymmetric; paired inference uses only the determinate paired-task intersection
secondaryMetrics: unchanged from Protocol v1/v2; this specification does not resolve, promote, or redefine them
